sourceNotes: 新增默认关闭的基础菜单栏折叠，可在设置中启用并点击系统箭头收起或展开不常用图标
修复 Homebrew 版本检查与卸载规则

en: Add optional basic menu bar folding, disabled by default, with system chevrons to collapse or expand less-used icons. Manually move icons to the left of the transparent divider; results depend on available screen space.
Fix Homebrew version checks and uninstall rules to distinguish XStats and Capture releases and preserve their shared screenshot and recording cache when either app is removed.
